2609.11390.title: VikingRAG: Accurate and Token-efficient Retrieval-augmented Generation over Structured Documents
2609.11390.paper_summary: State-of-the-art retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods exploit document structures to acquire sufficient evidence, but often incur substantial token costs. To reduce structural-context tokens without compromising high RAG accuracy, we present {\sf VikingRAG}, a directory-aware semantic data management system that tightly integrates semantic and structural access to support structural-context-efficient, evidence-gap-driven multi-round retrieval. To further reduce token overhead of multi-round interaction, we materialize agentic multi-round retrieval traces as experience edges, and reuse these edges for similar queries, avoiding repeated multi-round exploration. To additionally reduce token costs when agentic multi-round retrieval is unnecessary, we introduce an adaptive escalation strategy that answers from one-round experience-augmented retrieval when the evidence is sufficient, and invokes agentic multi-round retrieval only otherwise. Experiments on real datasets show that the base system {\sf VikingRAG} matches high accuracy of state-of-the-art methods while consuming only 11.6\%--51.9\% of their tokens. With retrieval-trace reuse and adaptive escalation, token costs drop to 5.1\%--32.5\% while maintaining competitive accuracy and practical document-storage performance, showing the utility of this work for emerging AI knowledge bases.
2609.11390.paper_summary_zh: 最先進的檢索增強生成（RAG）方法利用文檔結構來獲取足夠的證據，但通常會產生相當高的標記成本。為了在不妥協高 RAG 準確性的情況下減少結構上下文標記，我們提出了 {\sf VikingRAG}，這是一個目錄感知的語義數據管理系統，緊密整合語義和結構訪問，以支持結構上下文高效、以證據差距為驅動的多輪檢索。為了進一步減少多輪交互的標記開銷，我們將代理多輪檢索痕跡具象化為經驗邊緣，並重用這些邊緣以處理類似查詢，避免重複的多輪探索。為了在不需要代理多輪檢索時進一步減少標記成本，我們引入了一種自適應升級策略，當證據足夠時，從一輪經驗增強檢索中回答，否則才啟用代理多輪檢索。對真實數據集的實驗表明，基礎系統 {\sf VikingRAG} 在消耗僅 11.6\%--51.9\% 的標記的同時，達到了與最先進方法相當的高準確性。通過檢索痕跡重用和自適應升級，標記成本降至 5.1\%--32.5\%，同時保持競爭力的準確性和實用的文檔存儲性能，顯示了這項工作對新興 AI 知識庫的實用性。
